reason: Code that a dependency ships inside its own dist, outside bun.lock. The npm copies are transformed (ESM), so the bytes differ from the registry tarball; the version comes from the vendored path, and the license text was taken from the registry tarball of that version, whose integrity is recorded. The C/C++ projects compiled into a WebAssembly file have no registry tarball: the source is the repository commit the host builds from, and the license text was read at that commit.

packages.note: Compiled into dist/reader/zxing_reader.wasm. zxing-wasm 3.1.6 pins this commit as its zxing-cpp submodule and exports it as ZXING_CPP_COMMIT.

Image decoder compiled into dist/reader/zxing_reader.wasm (its error strings are in the file). zxing-cpp fetches stb from the default branch, unpinned, so the exact commit is unknown; the LICENSE file is unchanged since 49cbedf (2020-02-02). The console hands the reader decoded pixels, not image files.
